lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with four to five distinct spots visible in each column across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, specifically where the spots act as nodes within these vertical luminance gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more clustered than those found on the lateral flank.
